metadata.logline: Cornered and chained in the damp dungeon, Juliana shatters Catherine's cruelty with unshakeable dignity and the truth about love and worth, driving Catherine into a murderous fury.
metadata.continuity: Picks up immediately from Episode 31's cliffhanger where Catherine used a glowing branding iron to scorch Juliana's mother's herbal book.

units.text: Close-up on the open botanical ledger lying on the wet stone floor as the glowing red branding tip sizzles against the delicate parchment.
Sizzling, crackling sound of scorched parchment paper.
Close-up of Juliana, chained against the brick wall, tears glistening on her cheeks as she trembles in grief.
There it is.
units.speaker: CATHERINE

units.text: Low-angle medium shot of Catherine in her opulent velvet gown, clutching the hot poker with a sadistic sneer.
Fear.
units.speaker: CATHERINE

units.text: Close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward over the burning book, eyes glittering with malice.
You have been so proud of that brave little face...
units.speaker: CATHERINE

units.text: Wide shot showing Juliana chained against the cold dungeon wall, small and restrained beneath Catherine's towering shadow.
...but now you are afraid.
units.speaker: CATHERINE

units.text: Medium shot of Catherine straightening up haughtily.
Extreme close-up of Juliana, her lips trembling in agonizing sorrow.
Say goodbye to your mother.
units.speaker: CATHERINE

units.text: Low-angle shot of Catherine swinging the flaming orange iron upward from the book.
Juliana's despair suddenly solidifies. Her jaw tightens, tears stopping as resolve takes over.
Close-up of Juliana looking up directly at Catherine, fear replaced by cold conviction.
Burn it.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Medium close-up of Juliana, sitting upright despite her heavy iron shackles.
Close-up of Catherine, her smug expression abruptly flickering with startled confusion.
What?
units.speaker: CATHERINE

units.text: Low-angle close-up of Juliana staring straight up into Catherine's eyes without flinching.
Burn the ledger. Burn every page.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Wide shot of the wet dungeon floor, guards stationed by the heavy iron doorway in the background as Catherine holds the hot brand.
You may destroy the book...
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Close-up of Catherine's face darkening with irritation.
Medium low-angle shot of Juliana sitting amidst chains beneath the barred ceiling grate.
...you cannot destroy what my mother taught me.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Close-up of Catherine leaning down aggressively into Juliana's space, trembling with offended rage.
You think a few herbs make you better than me?
units.speaker: CATHERINE

units.text: Close-up of Juliana looking steadily up into Catherine's furious glare.
No. Your cruelty does that for me.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: High-angle over-the-shoulder shot looking down at Juliana bound in heavy chains on the damp floor.
Extreme close-up of Catherine, baring her teeth in outrage.
You still think you are better?!
units.speaker: CATHERINE

units.text: Medium shot of Juliana, her chained hands clasped together in her lap.
I know what I am.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Medium shot of Catherine scoffing with forced, derisive laughter.
A disgraced woman?
units.speaker: CATHERINE

units.text: Close-up of Juliana speaking with undeniable strength.
A woman who survived. You cannot destroy me.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Close-up of Catherine brandishing the glowing tong in Juliana's face, spittle flying from her lips.
You are lying!
units.speaker: CATHERINE

units.text: Close-up of Juliana looking straight up, voice steady and clear.
Gerald leaving me was the best thing he ever did for me.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Full shot of the dungeon cell. Catherine stands rigidly tall while Juliana sits shackled on the ground.
He wanted a woman who looked beautiful beside his wealth.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's expressive blue eyes and tear-stained cheek.
He wanted a wife whose family could raise his name. He measured a woman's worth by what she could give him.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Low-angle shot of Juliana leaning slightly forward against her chains.
Close-up of Catherine staring down, her eyes widening as Juliana's words pierce her facade.
Let him have Clarissa.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Close-up of Juliana smiling with genuine liberation.
He lost me.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Extreme close-up of Catherine's face contorting in sheer fury.
You were rejected!
units.speaker: CATHERINE

units.text: Close-up of Juliana's calm, resolute face.
I was freed. And I found a man who never asked me what I was worth.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Wide shot of the cell, steam rising faintly in the cold subterranean air.
Close-up of Catherine sneering with dripping condescension.
Your soldier?
units.speaker: CATHERINE

units.text: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glowing with genuine devotion.
My husband.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Close-up of Catherine scowling with deep disgust.
He is a nobody.
units.speaker: CATHERINE

units.text: Close-up of Juliana smiling softly, totally untroubled.
Then I love a nobody.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Low-angle shot focusing on Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron on the stone floor.
Because that nobody showed me more love than your entire world ever did.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Medium close-up of Catherine gripping the branding rod tighter, her upper lip curling in fury.
You know nothing about my world.
units.speaker: CATHERINE

units.text: Medium shot of Juliana sitting in her tattered apron and chains, looking composed.
I know exactly what your world values.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's lips and eyes as she lists them with chilling precision.
Beauty. Money.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Extreme close-up of Catherine's wide, stunned eyes reacting to the naked truth.
Close-up of Juliana looking up unflinchingly.
Family. A perfect name.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Low-angle shot of Catherine standing rigid in her gold and purple gown, the guard standing sentinel behind her.
And a woman who never embarrasses the people standing behind her.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Close-up of Catherine throwing her hands up in explosive defensiveness.
And what is wrong with that?!
units.speaker: CATHERINE

units.text: Close-up of Catherine's face twisting in absolute venom.
Close-up of Juliana looking serene.
Nothing. Until you have nothing left beneath it.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Medium shot of Catherine standing motionless, holding the iron rod, struck to the core by the insult.
You have spent your whole life collecting things that make people bow...
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Low-angle shot of Juliana's chained hands folded peacefully in her lap.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking up with quiet pity.
...but you have never learned how to make anyone love you.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Medium shot of Catherine snapping entirely, raising the branding poker like a weapon and screaming.
Silence! Silence!
units.speaker: CATHERINE

units.text: Close-up of Catherine's crazed, gasping face.
Why?!
units.speaker: CATHERINE

units.text: Close-up of Juliana crying out her defiance.
Because I am right!
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Low-angle tracking shot of the red-hot branding tip trailing across the wet dungeon floor, steaming.
You want everyone to believe you are powerful.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Medium shot of Juliana sitting under the cold skylight bars, her posture majestic despite her imprisonment.
You want everyone to fear you.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Medium shot of Juliana looking directly at Catherine, gestures restrained by the heavy iron chains.
But look at you.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes burning with fiery contempt.
You have to threaten a chained woman to feel powerful!
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Close-up of Catherine trembling with uncontrollable rage, teeth bared.
You insolent—!
units.speaker: CATHERINE

units.text: Medium shot of Catherine gripping the glowing tongs as Juliana continues speaking over her.
You may have the title you have always wanted...
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Close-up of Juliana delivering the final emotional blow.
...but you will never have the courage to earn what you demand from everyone else.
units.speaker: JULIANA

units.text: Close-up of Catherine's face twitching with sheer murderous madness.
You think you can lecture me?!
units.speaker: CATHERINE

units.text: Medium shot of Catherine raising the branding iron high above her head with both hands.
Catherine hoists the searing branding rod over Juliana with frantic fury.
Then let's see how brave you are when it touches your skin!
units.speaker: CATHERINE

units.text: Medium shot of Catherine plunging the glowing orange poker straight toward Juliana's face.
Juliana gasps, freezing as the glowing tip of the iron thrusts forward, stopping mere millimeters from her right eye.

Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, unblinking blue eye. The intense, fiery orange glow of the iron poker radiates inches from her cornea, holding on the heart-stopping cliffhanger as the frame cuts to black.
